text:
maria: Quick idea for the next webinar — focus on ops: "How teams set SLAs and cut inference costs". Want a playbook + short demo. Thoughts?

elena: Love it. Ops framing might pull both engineers and infra PMs. Can write two short abstracts.

jay: Audience = infra/platform engineers + eng managers. CTA: evaluation kit + invite to pilot Dedicated. I'll run a small LinkedIn test.

prashant: Happy to speak on technical patterns: batching windows, prefix KV caching, and graceful fallbacks. Will prepare 5 slides + one config snippet.

kevin: I'll create a one-slide visual that shows routing + fallback flow. Also a resource slide with QR and short lead form.

nora: Customer case: anonymized fintech saw ~30% lower tail latency after enabling batching + routing. Can present as a short story. Legal ok with anonymized metric.

maria: Run-of-show idea (40m):
- 0:00-0:03 intro + goals
- 0:03-0:18 ops playbook (prashant)
- 0:18-0:26 customer story (nora)
- 0:26-0:29 60s pre-recorded demo
- 0:29-0:37 live Q&A + polls
- 0:37-0:40 CTAs + follow-up resources

elena: Abstract drafts: A) "Set SLAs that match your product and budget — a practical checklist for inference ops." B) "How batching, caching, and intelligent routing reduced latency and costs in production." Which to lead with?

jay: Both work. Lead with A for subject line, use B in body copy. I'll A/B subjects: A = ops checklist, B = cost/latency wins.

prashant: Tech notes for slides: keep math simple. One slide with cost calc: tokens/sec * price/token * concurrency example. Also show a tiny pseudo-config for a fallback policy.

kevin: Need headshots and 2-line bios by Tue. Also want a short animated GIF (20s) illustrating fallback. I can mock.

nora: I'll prepare a one-slide before/after chart and a bulleted 'what we changed' list.

ops-bot: Webinar infra check: recording enabled, polls active, max attendees 2k.

maria: Lead routing plan: hidden field source=webinar_ops_slas, tag=webinar_ops. Engagement scoring: asked a question or clicked resource -> route to AE; otherwise nurture. Jay, you own HubSpot mapping?

jay: Yes. I'll set mapping and add an engaged-to-AE workflow. Also will allocate $1k ad test to LinkedIn.

elena: Promo timeline: week -3 announce + blog, week -2 ads + partners, week -1 reminders + social. Also prepare a short benchmark narrative: "customer observed ~30% P95 reduction" with a methodology line.

maria: Rehearsal plan: tech check 10m before start, dry run 2 days prior, dress 1 day prior. Pre-record demo as backup.

prashant: I'll upload demo MP4 and slide PDF backups. Also: provide 5 config snippets (short) for the handout.

kevin: I'll draft the resource slide and QR code. Will share v0 Monday.

nora: Legal asked we include a one-line methodology: "Anonymized customer metric measured over matched 2-week windows" — ok to include on landing page?

maria: Yes, include that exactly.

jay: Action items quick list:
- prashant: slides + demo MP4 + 5 snippets (due Wed)
- nora: anonymized chart + quote (due Wed)
- kevin: slide assets + GIF (due Mon)
- elena: two abstracts + email copy + subject lines (due Mon)
- jay: HubSpot mapping + paid brief (due Tue)
- maria: registration page + evaluation kit README (due Tue)

maria: One more: let's include a short FAQ for sales (3 bullets per persona). Alex from Sales will add after we have the first draft.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal room reserved Thu 09:00 PT.

elena: Locked topic, I'll post the landing copy in this thread when ready.

maria: Thanks team — aiming to announce next Wed. Please flag blockers early. :rocket:
